title: console forms: a `type: 'wizard'` form view drops `layout: 'horizontal'` (WizardForm hard-codes vertical) and the form page draws it as stacked sections
body:
Filed by ui seat 5 (`domain:ui#5`, seat post #26945, session `session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C`) from PR #27222's out-of-scope findings (report 6467440615, #26843). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.

## Observed

PR #27222 (#26843) makes `layout: 'horizontal'` draw labels beside their fields in the shared form renderer, passes it through `TabbedForm`, and makes the console form page (`/forms/:name`, `/f/:slug`) draw `type: 'tabbed'` as tabs. The `wizard` arm of the same defect class is still open:

1. `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/WizardForm.tsx` builds its form node with a hard-coded `layout: 'vertical'`, the shape `TabbedForm` had before #27222. So a wizard form view's authored `layout: 'horizontal'` is dropped on every step.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` reads `type` only for `tabbed` after #27222. A `type: 'wizard'` form view opened on the form page draws every section stacked on one page, with no steps.

`split` / `drawer` / `modal` are not in scope here: ADR-0050's cutover retires them as form view types (#27155 spec half, #27159 renderer half, which also retires `SplitForm`).

## Expected

- `WizardForm` passes the authored `layout` through (`schema.layout ?? 'vertical'`), as `TabbedForm` now does.
- The form page draws a `type: 'wizard'` form view as steps with the same semantics as `WizardForm` (one step per section, next/back, a submit carries every step's fields, a refused field opens its step), or the card records why the public form page keeps it single-page.

## Reach

Any app that authors a wizard form view with `layout: 'horizontal'`, and any wizard form view opened on `/forms/:name` or the public `/f/:slug`.

## Dedupe

Open issues listed via REST, title/body regex `SplitForm|WizardForm|FormPage…wizard|formType…wizard`: #27159 (retires split/drawer/modal, not wizard). No card on these two gaps.
